label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll rose steadily from 2 (15 Aug) to 73 (19 Aug) to 83 (21 Aug) to 87 (22 Aug) to 91 (23 Aug) to 100 (24 Aug) to 103 (25 Aug) as rescue teams reached remote villages; BNPB says many recent additions were indirect earthquake impacts (shock, falls, aftershock-triggered cardiac events) or hospitalized victims who could not be saved, rather than fresh structural-collapse fatalities.

label: Injured
contestNote: BNPB's 25 August tally cites 1,666 injured, up from 1,603 (24 Aug), 1,286 (23 Aug) and 1,298 (22 Aug); the injured count has swung both up and down across reporting days as regency-level tallies are reconciled.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: Figures climbed from 150,576 (23 Aug, 06:00 WIB) to 161,084 (23 Aug evening) to 180,327 (24 Aug) to 185,131 (25 Aug) as assessments reached isolated communities; Manggarai Timur regency alone accounted for 31,372 evacuees as of 23 Aug, the highest of any regency.

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BNPB's 24 August tally of 73,818 (23,276 severe, 17,563 moderate, 32,979 slight) supersedes the 53,971 figure reported 22 August; Manggarai and East Manggarai regencies remain the hardest hit. Figures remain preliminary pending by-name-by-address verification.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M1.1–M6.2 range; 6,409 recorded by 24 August (33 above M5.0, 139 felt), passing 7,029 by 25 August. BMKG's forecast of continued activity for 21–30 more days from the mainshock is unchanged.

label: Personnel Deployed
delta: 5,832 TNI + 238 Polri + 903 volunteers as of 22-23 Aug (up from 3,500+ TNI/Polri on 17 Aug)

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.

label: Schools Damaged
contestNote: 92% of the education-sector assessment complete as of 21 August: 5,521 classrooms damaged, 502 school buildings severely damaged, affecting 177,678 students and 21,166 teachers/staff.
